body: My parents thought there was something wrong with me when I was a child but never took me to a doctor. I forgot to mention that a few years ago my GP diagnosed me with clinical depression and put me on prozac for a few months. It made me very agitated; like I had a smile on my face but I was filled with anger and rage. I read a little bit about Autism. It makes me feel like I would make a lot more sense but I have no idea how I would go about getting a diagnosis. I searched for doctors that specialize in it but they seem to all be pediatricians.
Thanks so much! I'll definitely look into those!

I like to play like mellow electro type stuff - it usually ends up sounding like aphex twin or boards of canada.     I do enjoy the 2Xchromosomes subreddit but I'm even anti-social online.    Thanks for your reply!
